notes: Scope (lead decision 6): code that the stage-1 code imports or runs (imports, path loads and the kit's pack lists), the tests of that code with their test-time imports, the frozen texts and their verification documents. Configs (decision 3): only those named by stage-1 code, the frozen readers, the preflight scripts or the frozen texts, plus engine X's identity record. Allow entries without a wildcard are exact paths: they must exist at the revision and win over deny globs. Rules are matched in this order on the original text; an earlier rule wins an overlap. Tokens follow research/experiments/2026-10-23-osf-deposit-package/REDACTIONS.md. code_ok rules (local folder paths, decision 1) also apply in code strings and non-prose files. redact_pinned: files redacted with exactly the listed rules (the OSF deposit's categories). repin: pinned files redacted anyway, their quoted hashes updated inside the export (decision 1). accepted: checker hits kept on purpose (decisions 2, 4, 5 and the size exception), with exact counts and reasons.
